notes: The kills in this window fell on opposite sides of the map (duo lane and offlane): two separate plays, not one fight.

closingNote: Closed slow — we led objectives but the game ran 42 minutes. Convert Fangtooth/tower leads into ending the game, don't farm the lead and risk a throw.

coaching.headline: We won all eight fights and they won none — but only three cashed into a prize, and that's how an 8–5 tower lead ran 42 minutes.
coaching.team: The fighting was never the problem: eight clustered fights, eight wins, zero losses — the enemy's entire game was solo catches (seven of us caught rotating alone; they never won a fight). The story is the cash-in: only three of the eight wins bought a prize within 90 seconds, and at 41.2 and 41.8 we were still winning fights at our own inhibitor and core. Repeat the fight discipline; the one sharpen is treating the 90 seconds after a won fight as tower time, and cutting the solo picks — the catches at 27, 27.8 and 29.9 (three of us, alone, in under three minutes) are exactly the stall that kept a beaten team alive.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Fight conversion, eventually: only three of eight fight wins cashed into a prize within 90 seconds — a game that eight fight wins should have ended sooner; the five uncashed wins are the 42 minutes.

perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Steel with zero deaths, 16 assists and 15 wards — nothing to fix in the fights, and Goldilocks324 never gave them a body all game. The sharpen is the close: five fight wins bought no prize, and with the lane read Goldilocks324's way early, Steel is the one free to lead the group onto a tower in those 90 seconds — towers only ran 8–5 across 42 minutes.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow 10/3/5 in a carry lane that read theirs all game against Murdock — Cuban Noobster beat the matchup read outright. Two of the three deaths were solo catches outside any fight (9.3 and 27.8), and the 27.8 one sat in the 27–29.9 stretch of three solo picks that stalled the push. Rotate with a body alongside and this ends well before 42.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Phase 2/2/14 — that vision is a big part of why they never won a fight. The sharpen: Willy Guggenheim sees the map best, so own the cash-in call — only three of eight wins bought a prize within 90 seconds. Call the tower while they're dead and the 42-minute win is a 30-minute one.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Riktor. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.
